usage.inputs: {} returns the catalog. template_id selects M01–M19 or R01–R11. Optional sections replaces the whole suggested section list; each section may copy module_id, then replace fields with keys or custom definitions. Custom sections require id/title/fields. Field overrides accept label/type/meaning/unit/required/display. method_refs and context bind expected method and subject/as_of/target/horizon without running analysis. locale defaults to zh-CN. Chart fields define kind/options/columns/data_requirements and receive fixed value:{rows,source_note,takeaway,options?}. Confidence, probability, inference and historical-chart outputs require historical_basis; see module-templates.md and module-visuals.md. history_display selects full/summary/hidden evidence presentation. Historical sampling defaults to the current instrument within the declared recent window; cross-instrument fallback requires a completed zero-match primary search with a fixed result reference. Explicit user overrides are recorded.
usage.outputs: {kind:catalog,modules,compositions} or {kind:structure,schemaVersion,template_id,locale,sections}; every resolved field includes key/label/type/meaning/required/display. Defaults are not persisted. Pass the same input as report_compose.structure, not this resolved output. Selected agent_guidance.lineage describes result origin/nature for internal use only; it does not select indicators, algorithms or provider routes.
limitations: Templates are suggestions. Explicit arrays replace rather than merge defaults. Required defaults to false; omissions do not trigger hidden research. Structure validity is not research validity.
Combined templates keep conclusions concise, feature evidence in the history section, and one final combined scenario tree; explicit user section/field lists override these suggestions.

Reuse built-in chart fields including candlesticks; confidence must trace to comparable historical scenarios and realized outcomes.
usage.inputs: output_path/title/structure/results_ref are required; summary is optional. results_ref is a fixed json-rows DataRef containing section_id, field, status, value or reason, optional method_ref/theory_refs/evidence_refs/context/validation. Read skills/report-writing/module-templates.md for row formats. Field/section arrays and ordering come entirely from the effective structure. Chart fields define kind/options/columns/data_requirements and receive fixed value:{rows,source_note,takeaway,options?}. Confidence, probability, inference and historical-chart outputs require historical_basis; see module-templates.md and module-visuals.md. history_display selects full/summary/hidden evidence presentation. Historical sampling defaults to the current instrument within the declared recent window; cross-instrument fallback requires a completed zero-match primary search with a fixed result reference. Explicit user overrides are recorded. Optional origin records actual kind/nature/source/refs and mixed component paths; acquired values need source identity and fixed evidence, derived/inferred values identify the actual method. Explicit inferences include reasoning:{observations,steps,conclusion,history:{status,note}}. linked history needs the same result historical_basis; pending/unavailable do not create probability. See field-guide.md for this method-neutral result format.
usage.outputs: Generated preview path plus publish.content and publish.style. Add the required metadata and complete data references, then call report_publish followed by report_check. The preview HTML cannot be uploaded.
prerequisites: An active writable workspace and an immutable json-rows DataRef of existing research outputs.
Supplied selected methods and contexts must match the result rows.
limitations: No market fetching, feature computation, history matching, forecasting, calibration, publication or rendering inspection is executed here.
Selected field type/method/context errors fail before writing. Missing required results remain explicit partial reports; missing optional defaults are omitted.

Probability/confidence require a method, explicit validation state and fixed comparable-scenario/outcome evidence. Each inference has its own evidence; final synthesis needs its own historical basis, never an average of feature confidence.
At most 64 sections, 64 fields per section, 4096 result rows, 4 MiB source JSON, and 1 MiB HTML. Custom charts and further visual edits can use the existing document and chart tools.

Built-in charts render fixed rows without estimating statistics; per chart at most 2500 rows. Missing history is unavailable, never a subjective confidence score. Reference and count checks do not certify scientific validity.
Combined templates keep conclusions concise, feature evidence in the history section, and one final combined scenario tree; explicit user section/field lists override these suggestions.
